a.lede: Nvidia is rolling out a new GPU driver today (621.01) that enables Microsoft's new Advanced Shader Delivery technology to speed up game launches. The technology also removes mid-game "just-in-time" shader compilation, reducing stuttering and CPU spikes. a.title: Nvidia’s latest GPU driver brings a new way to speed up PC games

b.lede: Nvidia's latest DLSS Neural Renderer, extracted from NBA 2K27 (again), is being tested on unsupported games and shows up to a 90% performance gain over the previous NR model.
b.title: Official DLSS 5 running on unsupported games delivers up to 90% better performance than the leaked version
